conclusions_markdown:
# LIFECYCLE v2 - verified claims

Generated automatically from persisted runs; only computed hypotheses with run IDs are listed. Model-conditional; not investment advice.

- **H1-v2** (Optimal fixed-income allocation responds to signed net flow after conditioning on age): OLS slope of CE-optimal bond share on planned q, path bootstrap = -0.1747 (95% CI -0.4102 to 0.4541), Holm-adjusted p = 1. Verdict: contradicted; evidence grade: contradicted. Run `3c15e68b970135cb144d`, data ['1953-05-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: 0 of 7 ages exclude zero
- **H2-v2** (Cash-flow-aware allocation improves lifetime CE): OOS dCE of the cell-optimal (age+q) policy over the age-only policy = -0.003821 (95% CI -0.006678 to -0.0007655), Holm-adjusted p = 0.0452. Verdict: contradicted; evidence grade: contradicted. Run `3c15e68b970135cb144d`, data ['1953-05-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
- **H3-v2** (Bond utility varies with inflation / stock-bond dependence regime): difference in bond-sleeve dCE between starting regimes = -0.04018 (95% CI -0.1719 to 0.09158), Holm-adjusted p = 1. Verdict: fragile; evidence grade: diagnostic. Run `ea3c0f79c972a42d7904`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
- **H4-v2** (Additional sleeves improve sustainability in some states): Shapley CE ($/yr) of the best additional sleeve = 2628 (95% CI 2234 to 3164), Holm-adjusted p = 0. Verdict: supported; evidence grade: conditional. Run `ea3c0f79c972a42d7904`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
- **H5** - not computed (no completed input run).
- **H6** (Cash-flow-aware rebalancing improves net CE vs calendar): paired dCE cash-flow targeting vs annual calendar = -0.009043 (95% CI -0.01296 to -0.005541), Holm-adjusted p = 8.78e-06. Verdict: contradicted; evidence grade: contradicted. Run `b42f4a607fb70c037045`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
- **H7** (Bond duration affects outcomes beyond total bond share): CE($) long minus short duration at equal weight = -3162. Verdict: fragile; evidence grade: diagnostic. Run `35d7cddf0eec1387129d`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: no paired CI computed for this contrast
- **H8** (Point-in-time macro conditioning improves OOS utility): holdout CE of regime-conditional vs static (disjoint test paths) = 0.04762. Verdict: supported; evidence grade: conditional. Run `ea3c0f79c972a42d7904`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: simulation holdout; chronological walk-forward reported in RS-05
- **H9** (Survival-optimal and CE-optimal allocations diverge in some region): max |b_CE - b_survival| over r in [3%,7%] = 0.35. Verdict: supported; evidence grade: conditional. Run `15396257c3d3bfcb163e`, data ['1953-05-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
- **H10** (Equity-bond co-loss probability explains nonlinear bond value): regime-dependence of bond value (co-loss regime proxy via inflation-ordered MS states) = -0.04018 (95% CI -0.1719 to 0.09158), Holm-adjusted p = 1. Verdict: fragile; evidence grade: diagnostic. Run `ea3c0f79c972a42d7904`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: co-loss frequencies by regime: see Fixed Income FI-13
- **H11** (A cash/TIPS buffer reduces early-retirement shortfall): reduction in P(shortfall in first 10y), 1y buffer = -0 (95% CI -0 to -0). Verdict: fragile; evidence grade: diagnostic. Run `35d7cddf0eec1387129d`, data ['1977-03-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
- **H12** (Thresholds are stable enough to communicate): median bootstrap width of b_min near the frontier (1 grid points); model agreement 98% = 0.1. Verdict: supported; evidence grade: conditional. Run `15396257c3d3bfcb163e`, data ['1953-05-31', '2026-09-30']. Caveat: model-conditional
